title: Failed to delete user: Database error deleting user
body:
https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/exampleprojectid/auth/users 

I'm unable to delete users from this page. it gives me this error. I tried logout and login but it doesn't work

comments.author: zensajnani
comments.body:
i fixed it using this SQL to list the tables referencing auth.users(id), and updating their on delete to CASCADE.

-- Lists all FKs pointing at auth.users(id), and how deletes are handled
SELECT
  conrelid::regclass         AS referencing_table,
  a.attname                  AS referencing_column,
  confrelid::regclass        AS referenced_table,
  af.attname                 AS referenced_column,
  CASE c.confdeltype
    WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION'
    WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT'
    WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE'
    WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL'
    WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT'
  END                        AS on_delete
FROM pg_constraint c
JOIN pg_attribute a
  ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (c.conkey)
JOIN pg_attribute af
  ON af.attrelid = c.confrelid AND af.attnum = ANY (c.confkey)
WHERE c.contype = 'f'
  AND c.confrelid = 'auth.users'::regclass
  AND af.attname = 'id'
ORDER BY referencing_table, referencing_column;

comments.author: DelgshSeli
comments.body:
Check user Storage ownership
In the Dashboard, find the user and check whether they own any files in Storage.
If they do, either delete those objects or reassign ownership to another user.

Check the actual Postgres error
Go to:

Auth logs: Dashboard → Logs → Auth logs
(In my case, deletion was blocked because public.bak_submissions.user_id has a foreign key to auth.users(id).)
Postgres logs: Dashboard → Logs → Postgres logs

Then try deleting the user again and copy the exact SQLSTATE / error message from the logs. It usually points to the failing trigger, function, or constraint.
